description: Prepare one unsigned Hyperliquid native perpetual limit/IOC order or first-time 0.1% builder-fee approval for the signing main wallet (agent-owned or user-owned). Does not sign, submit, change leverage or create an API wallet. Requires configured QHooks builder and an allowed edge region.

limitPrice.description: Explicit price bound in USD. IOC can partly fill or cancel; never an unbounded market order.

nonce.description: Fresh millisecond nonce allocated by the user wallet; coordinate with its other Hyperliquid actions.

size.description: Exact base-coin size; never USDC notional.

name: prepare_perps_order
title: Prepare a perpetual order
